android.desc:
Improve your golf swing with watch tracking, video analysis and AI coaching.

FocusGolf automatically captures swings from your Wear OS or Garmin watch, tracks shots and distances, and brings your practice history into one place.

No club sensors. No extra hardware. Just your smartwatch, your golf swing and your practice.

GOLF SWING ANALYSIS
Let your watch capture the swing while you focus on the ball.

• Automatic golf swing detection
• Swing tempo and swing speed
• Consistency and transition data
• Motion-based swing metrics
• Complete practice-session history
• Save and revisit your best swings

Instead of trying to remember why one shot felt better than another, Focus Golf gives you data you can review after every practice session.

VIDEO GOLF SWING ANALYSIS
Combine golf swing video with motion and shot data.
Record or add swing videos and review them together with information captured by your watch.

• Review golf swing videos
• Connect video with swing metrics
• Save your best shots
• Create highlights
• Compare swings and sessions over time

See how the swing looked, how it felt and what the data showed.

SHOT TRACKER & CLUB DISTANCES
Track your shots during practice or while playing golf.

• Record golf shots and clubs
• Review shot distances
• Track performance by club
• Build your personal club-distance history
• Review shot patterns
• Follow changes in distance and consistency

The more you practice, the more useful your history becomes.

GPS GOLF & ROUND TRACKING
Take FocusGolf onto the course.
Use GPS-based golf features to track your round, record shots and keep useful information available from your watch.
Review your round afterwards together with your shots, clubs, distances and golf statistics.

BUILT FOR WEAR OS & GARMIN
FocusGolf is designed around your smartwatch rather than treating it as a simple remote control.
Capture swings and shots from your wrist, see useful information while you practice or play, then review the complete session on your Android phone.
Less time touching your phone. More time focused on golf.

AI GOLF COACHING
Use swing, video and shot data to understand what you should work on next.
FocusGolf brings your practice history together so you can identify patterns, revisit good swings and make your next practice session more focused.

PRACTICE WITH MEMORY
A score tells you what happened. FocusGolf helps you remember how it happened.

• Find swings you want
